description: UI test class for BookmarksScreen composable in an Android app, testing loading states, bookmark display, removal, empty state, and lifecycle behavior.

classes.name: BookmarksScreenTest
classes.description: Test suite for the BookmarksScreen composable, covering loading, display, removal, empty state, and lifecycle behavior.

methods.name: loading_showsLoadingSpinner
methods.description: Tests that the loading spinner is shown when the feed state is loading.

methods.name: feed_whenHasBookmarks_showsBookmarks
methods.description: Verifies that bookmarks are displayed correctly when present.

methods.name: feed_whenRemovingBookmark_removesBookmark

methods.name: feed_whenHasNoBookmarks_showsEmptyState
